attributes.name: Bewilder
attributes.powers: Discard this card to evade a monster you encounter; put it on the bottom of its location deck. If you are exploring, you may immediately explore again.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have the Arcane skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at an Arcane 16 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
attributes.source: ROTR-6, BARD-6, FIGHTER-6, GOBB-6, OA2-6, WIZARD-6, UI-6

corrections.corrected_text: On the spell Bewilder, change the second sentence of the first power to "If you are exploring, you may immediately explore again."
corrections.issue: Can I use Bewilder when I'm not exploring?
